$comment: Worlds the signed-out footer E2E (022, 023, 024) cannot visit, and the exact facts that make that true.
This is JSON, not a module, because the Playwright specs and the node law both have to read it and
Playwright transpiles .ts to CommonJS - importing an .mjs from a spec dies with 'Cannot use import.meta
outside a module', which Playwright reports as 'No tests found'. A whole suite passing by finding nothing
is the same disease this file exists to cure, so the two sides share data and never import each other.
'evidence' is re-checked by __tests__/the-footer-gate-tests-a-world-that-exists.law.test.mjs. When a listed
literal is gone, the law fails and a person decides whether the world has earned its coverage back.
